rust.name: crates/domain/src/kit.rs:104:64: replace != with == in Kit::choose_on
rust.why: This reverses which checkout pins permit the named account, and the scenario uses an unpinned checkout.

rust.name: crates/domain/src/kit.rs:110:67: replace <= with > in Kit::choose_on
rust.why: The scenario starts a named account without recording its quota, so it may miss that this mutation admits an exhausted account.

rust.name: crates/domain/src/issue.rs:63:29: replace && with || in On::is_none
rust.why: This drops the role or account from the opening event when only one is set, and the scenario sets both fields or neither.

rust.name: crates/factorium/src/session/launch.rs:367:19: replace match guard theirs.is_dir() with true in role_dir
rust.why: This can leave a dangling skills symlink for a role without a skills directory, and the tested role has one.

rust.name: crates/harness/src/harness/store.rs:136:58: replace && with || in spent
rust.why: This can count usage from a file that looks relevant but never records the worker's turn, a case the session tests do not exercise.
